title: Ya hussain
body:
Ya hussain
(Hussain hussain hussain) x3
<<MINI>>
(Mere lahu ke har qatre mei gunj raha hai ya Hussain, ab to sabka vird zubaa(n) bhi rehna laga hai ya Hussain) x2
<<DIVIDER>>
Aap ki kya shaan hai maula, bolta quran hai maula
Fatema ki jaan hai maula, Marzi-e-subhan hai maula
<<MINI>>
(Mere lahu ke har qatre mei gunj raha hai ya Hussain, ab to sabka vird zubaa(n) bhi rehna laga hai ya Hussain) x2
<<DIVIDER>>
Karbala ka fat'he azaam bakhuda hai waris-e-Adam
Jabajaa phehle tere par aam ta abad hoga tera matam
<<MINI>>
(Mere lahu ke har qatre mei gunj raha hai ya Hussain, ab to sabka vird zubaa(n) bhi rehna laga hai ya Hussain) x2
<<DIVIDER>>
Teen din ki tishnagi maula haaye teri bekasi maula
Khushk ghardan par churi maula, karbala kehti rahi maula
<<MINI>>
(Mere lahu ke har qatre mei gunj raha hai ya Hussain, ab to sabka vird zubaa(n) bhi rehna laga hai ya Hussain) x2
<<DIVIDER>>
Kistarha bhoolenge wo manzar jab chala tha halk pe khanjar
Jab sina ki nok pe tha sar bol tha Qur'an tere lab par
<<MINI>>
(Mere lahu ke har qatre mei gunj raha hai ya Hussain, ab to sabka vird zubaa(n) bhi rehna laga hai ya Hussain) x2
<<DIVIDER>>
Ye sabile ye azakhana aankh mei ashko(n) se paymaane
Matmi laaye hai nazraane ab janaab-e-sayyeda jaane
<<MINI>>
(Mere lahu ke har qatre mei gunj raha hai ya Hussain, ab to sabka vird zubaa(n) bhi rehna laga hai ya Hussain) x2
<<DIVIDER>>
Ye teri maula azadari zindagi se bhi hame pyaari
Hai yahi tujse wafadari ashk ankho(n) se rahe jaari
<<MINI>>
(Mere lahu ke har qatre mei gunj raha hai ya Hussain, ab to sabka vird zubaa(n) bhi rehna laga hai ya Hussain) x2
<<DIVIDER>>
Waris-e-Qur'an zindabaad rehbar-e-insaan zindabad
Mazhar-e-imaan zindabad fatema ki jaan zindabad
<<MINI>>
(Mere lahu ke har qatre mei gunj raha hai ya Hussain, ab to sabka vird zubaa(n) bhi rehna laga hai ya Hussain) x2
<<DIVIDER>>
As-salaam ay malike kausar as-salaam ay kushta-e-khanjar
As-salaam ay jaan-e-payghambar kehte hai "Rehan-o-Sarwar"
<<MINI>>
(Mere lahu ke har qatre mei gunj raha hai ya Hussain, ab to sabka vird zubaa(n) bhi rehna laga hai ya Hussain) x2
